Question 17
?

Find the equation of the left-opening parabola that has its vertex at (5,1) and passes through the point (−1,5).

a
(y−1)2=83(x−5)
b
(y−1)2=−83(x−5)
c
(y−5)2=−83(x−1)
d
(y−1)2=43(x−5)
e
(y−1)2=−43(x−5)
